reason: The README describes a packaged skill for creating styled academic handwritten HTML presentations and exporting each slide as a PNG, so themes and layout are the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于创建16:9学术手写风格HTML幻灯片，并将每页导出为1920×1080 PNG图片。
summaries.en: Creates 16:9 academic handwritten-style HTML slide decks and exports each slide as a 1920×1080 PNG image.

capabilities: Generates 16:9 Notability-style academic handwritten HTML slide decks
Exports slides as 1920×1080 PNG images using Google Chrome
Provides packaged templates, styles, scripts, examples, prompts, and preview assets
